question: Which river is associated with the Mohenjo-daro site?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohenjo-daro** is one of the most prominent urban centers of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, which flourished around 2500 BCE.
 
• The site is located along the banks of the **Indus River** in present-day **Sindh province, Pakistan**.
 
• The **Indus River** played a crucial role in the development of the civilization due to its **fertile plains** and the availability of water for agriculture.
 
• Mohenjo-daro is famous for its well-planned city layout, which included **grid-pattern streets, drainage systems, and advanced water storage facilities**.
 
• The site is also home to the **Great Bath**, which is considered one of the earliest examples of public water architecture.
 
• The Indus Valley Civilization, often referred to as the **Harappan Civilization**, is known for its advanced urban planning, trade systems, and cultural developments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Saraswati River**__

 __
 
• The **Saraswati River** is often mentioned in ancient Indian texts such as the **Rigveda**.
 
• It is believed to have been a major river during the Vedic period but is now considered a **lost river**.
 
• Some historians and scientists associate the Saraswati River with the **Ghaggar-Hakra River system**.
 
• While the Saraswati River has significance in Indian mythology, there is no concrete evidence linking it to Mohenjo-daro.
 
 
 
• **Ganga River**__
 __
 
• The **Ganga River** is one of the most sacred rivers in India and is associated with the **Gangetic Plain**.
 
• It is geographically located far from the Indus Valley Civilization sites and is not linked to Mohenjo-daro.
 
• The Ganga River basin was central to the development of later civilizations in India, such as the **Magadha and Maurya empires**.
 
 
 
• **Yamuna River**__
 
 
• The **Yamuna River** is a major tributary of the Ganga River.
 
• It flows through northern India, including prominent cities like **Delhi, Agra, and Mathura**.
 
• The Yamuna River is not geographically connected to the Indus Valley Civilization or Mohenjo-daro.
